statement: The organism answered held-out GSM8K word problems with programs it induced itself, with no model call. It parsed each of 1090 development questions into quantities with roles, searched bottom-up, one class per leaf set and value, the programs of at most 4 operations in a DSL of 19 primitives that reproduces the development answer (it found one for 989, 90.7%; for 769 the program follows the record's own worked solution), and kept 405 programs that each reproduce at least 2 development records under one cue pattern. Asked through those kept programs only, the 200 held-out records (never opened while the parse, the DSL or a program was written: the search opened 0 of them) were answered 196 times and 11 answers were right (5.5% of held out, precision 5.6%), each with its program as provenance; 8 of the right ones used a program that follows the record's worked solution. The template and word reader row on the same 200 was 1 right. The placebo control, the same programs with the cue patterns shuffled, got 6 right. An answer takes a median 15400 ns (parse, lookup and program run), the program run alone 38.8 ns (a bracket of 1000 runs). On development, leaving each record's own support out, 63 of 1067 answers were right (5.9%): most answers are still wrong, which is the next rung (the residual miner and a better parse), stated here so the number is not read as solved.

placebo.what: the same kept programs, each level's pattern-to-programs map shuffled
